title: Who directed the WPA band, and cutting it down to c. 1938
summary: Louis Domaine directed the band while another man ran the project and picked out bad notes; the band was cut down around 1938. They talk about framing and keeping the photos.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Quitting the band: why sidemen left

blocks.x: That's Louis Domaine. Can you tell me, there was another fella took charge of the band, I heard once, Joe Martinez or something they talk about. Mm-hmm. Was he a director of the band for a while, too, or what happened?

Yeah, he had the band in charge, you see. Yeah, he was, Louis Domaine was directing the band. But he was supposed to be the director, but he'd put another man of the band. Sort of in charge of the band. Sort of in charge of the whole project or something. Oh, that's right. Yeah, I didn't know how that... Yeah, he had the whole project in charge. But that man would stand off and pick out what man making a bad note when they got on to this amount of men, you see. Oh, yeah.
Yeah. Cut it down to that. Yeah. So this would be, this is 35, 32nd, 35. When would that be about then, Manuel? When they cut it down? This one here? Mm-hmm.
Let's see, that must have been about 38. 38. No, yeah, about 38, I believe. What's that?
Look at him laughing about a couple of pictures there. A fellow from England, Peter Dukak.
Oh, yeah. It's an old picture hat and a frame and bought me.
Yeah, I'm going to paste that on something good to keep it...
Yeah, I'm going to try and see it.
I can help you fix it up if you want me to do something. Yeah.
I'll stick it in a frame for you if you like, Manuel. What size is that? I'm going to take... 8 by 10. 8 by 10. I've got a couple of frames I could put them in.
A few more years and those will be destroyed at that rate. No, I have no record. In pieces, nobody will know who was on the band.
Mm-hmm. Well, during the time, everybody could have had one. They're selling them for 50 cents.
Yeah? I bought one and the guy said, well, I'm going to do it down.
I said, okay. He has to come. You see. A lot of other fellows would like to have that. That's right.
